text:
maria: Quick async standup — gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits
maria: What I did: landed the small proxy change to lift 429 thresholds for internal clients (PR #2342), added a signal to emit per-route thrift metrics
ken: Nice. Saw the PR, left a small comment about the token bucket default. I'll follow up in review
priya: Blockers: running into weird auth header ordering in staging — service B rejects when header order != expected. Trying to reproduce locally
maria: Ah, last week Lucas noted a proxied header normalization flag. @lucas any idea?
lucas: Yeah that's the `preserve_header_order` flag in envoy-ish layer. Default is false. If you flip it to true it keeps original order. We should probably set it for service B only.
priya: thx. Testing now — if it works i'll open a small config tweak PR
hannah: FYI: alerting noise on 429s earlier was from a burst origin. We had a burst policy misconfigured — fixed and muted alerts. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment mariaprod-gateway v1.12.3 succeeded in 6m 18s
ken: Quick question on rate limits: can we raise per-route burst to 50 for internal services? Current is 20 and causing throttles during batch jobs
maria: I'm cautious. Could we instead add a short-lived bypass header for internal jobs and gate it with authz check?
ken: That would work. Example header `x-rw-internal-burst: allowed` — could check in authz.
priya: For the auth header ordering, flipping `preserve_header_order` to true fixed staging. I'll open config PR and add a note to the runbook.
lucas: I'll review the PR. Also can we add a unit test that simulates scrambled header ordering? simple curl with `-H` repeated should do it.
hannah: Today: pair with @maria on rollout plan for the burst header, draft a canary, and tidy runbook. Also will patch the alert suppression window to 10m.
maria: Thanks. If PRs land today I'll queue a small canary during low-traffic window (22:30 UTC). Ping here when ready.
ken: I'll make the small authz check helper and ping for review. ETA 2-3h.
priya: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/infra/commit/abcd1234 — includes config, runbook note
maria: Reviewing now. If it looks good i'll merge and coordinate the canary.
lucas: quick lgtm on config file formatting
maria: Closing loop: blockers resolved by preserving header order; plan to add bypass header gated by authz; canary tonight
hannah: ack
ken: ack
priya: ack
